{ "item": { "id": "67e28ef9-df46-446a-9839-8f4bd0b23de1", "content_type": "generic", "workflow_state": "public", "page_title": "Authentication", "short_description": "Authenticate API requests with a bearer API key.", "body": "

Authentication

\n

Every request to the Godzilla API is authenticated with a bearer API key.

\n\n

Getting an API key

\n

Generate one from your workspace settings. Keys are scoped to a single workspace and inherit the standard rate limit described in Rate limits & errors.

\n\n

Using the key

\n{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\"}}\n\n{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Never expose a key client-side|body_html=

API keys carry full workspace access. Keep them server-side only — never embed one in a mobile app, browser bundle, or public repository.

}}\n\n

Verifying webhook requests

\n

Incoming webhook deliveries are authenticated differently: by a signed X-Godzilla-Signature header rather than your API key.

\n\n{{ds:component/docs-pagination|prev_href={{cms:item/1aaa9856-f563-4263-929f-16e234970286}}|prev_label=Quickstart|next_href={{cms:item/2df76640-838b-4256-956e-d8a19a602241}}|next_label=Building your first pipeline}}", "version_token": "61f9af8f-c603-4678-9405-7a0288c56be1", "created_at": "2026-08-20T14:15:19.935Z", "updated_at": "2026-08-20T15:07:12.009Z", "placement_id": "a8665e39-d994-43d7-9f40-791673ac7d44", "folder_id": "08088d6d-fe4a-4704-b265-9636d2cd750e", "file_name": "getting-started-authentication" } }

Short definitions for every term used throughout these docs.

Pipeline
A named, versioned workflow that moves data from a source connector, through optional transforms, to a destination connector.
Connector
A pre-built integration to an external system — a source, a destination, or both.
Event
The atomic unit of data moving through a pipeline, or a platform lifecycle notification like pipeline.failed.
Schema
A declarative contract specifying the structure, types, and validation rules for event payloads.
Webhook
An outbound HTTP request Godzilla sends to a URL you control when a subscribed event occurs.
Dead-letter queue
Where an event goes after exhausting its retries, rather than being dropped. See Handling errors & retries.
Cursor pagination
The pagination style used by every v2 list endpoint. See Rate limits & errors.

Usage allowances assigned to a workspace based on its plan tier, covering request throughput and monthly event volume. See Quotas & billing.

The top-level account boundary an API key is scoped to.

args.short_description: Install the Godzilla SDK or start calling the REST API directly.
args.body:
Installation

Godzilla has no server to install — it's a hosted platform you reach over the REST API, either directly or through an SDK.

Option A: Use an SDK

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=npm install @godzilla/sdk # or pip install godzilla-sdk # or go get github.com/godzilla/godzilla-go}}

Full setup for each is in Node.js SDK, Python SDK, and Go SDK.

Option B: Call the API directly

No install needed — every endpoint in the API reference is a plain HTTPS request.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Next|body_html=

Either way, you'll need an API key before you can make a request — that's covered in Authentication, next.

}} {{ds:component/docs-pagination|prev_href={{cms:item/24e76b35-144f-47a4-b3f1-ae085e5ee27c}}|prev_label=Concepts|next_href={{cms:item/1aaa9856-f563-4263-929f-16e234970286}}|next_label=Quickstart}}

Authentication

Every request to the Godzilla API is authenticated with a bearer API key.

Getting an API key

Generate one from your workspace settings. Keys are scoped to a single workspace and inherit the standard rate limit described in Rate limits & errors.

Using the key

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Never expose a key client-side|body_html=

API keys carry full workspace access. Keep them server-side only — never embed one in a mobile app, browser bundle, or public repository.

}}

Verifying webhook requests

Incoming webhook deliveries are authenticated differently: by a signed X-Godzilla-Signature header rather than your API key.

{{ds:component/docs-pagination|prev_href={{cms:item/1aaa9856-f563-4263-929f-16e234970286}}|prev_label=Quickstart|next_href={{cms:item/2df76640-838b-4256-956e-d8a19a602241}}|next_label=Building your first pipeline}}
